prompt:
Challenge C088-CH2: Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.
Detail: At two dairy plants we service — one near Temerin, one outside

content.text:
Let me analyze the challenge and researchers.

Core work: Characterise the foulant in dairy MBR membranes and identify practical changes to extend cleaning intervals.

R0269 (Bogdanović): Directly on dairy membrane fouling, CIP, whey protein, foulant characterisation. Clear can_do.

R0745 (Marić): Membrane filtration, fouling, wastewater treatment, food-industry effluents. Can do.

R0281 (Zdravković): Biomass/enzyme/biorefinery - cannot.

R0947 (Filipović): Photocatalysis/pharmaceuticals - cannot.
R0185 (Jovanović) works mainly on textile wastewater, though she has one publication on ultrafiltration fouling mechanisms. Her core focus still seems too dye/textile-specific to be a strong fit here.
